results.overview: Britain's best amateur bakers compete in the iconic white tent - all united in their aim to prove their baking skills and impress judges Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith.
results.name: The Great British Bake Off

results.overview: This British television baking competition selects from amongst its competitors the best amateur baker. The series is credited with reinvigorating interest in baking throughout the UK, and many of its participants, including winners, have gone on to start a career based on baking.
results.name: The Great British Bake Off

results.original_name: The Great British Bake Off: An Extra Slice
results.overview: The show that gives fans another bite of Bake Off when one helping just isn't enough. Jo Brand chats to a panel of celebrities about all the action, and meets the latest baker to leave the tent.
results.name: The Great British Bake Off: An Extra Slice

results.original_name: The Great British Bake Off: An Extra Slice
results.overview: Jo Brand is joined by three different celebrity Bake Off fans to shine a spotlight on the good, the bad and the soggy bottomed from the most recent episode.
results.name: The Great British Bake Off: An Extra Slice

results.overview: A spinoff of 'The Great British Bake Off', this show features children aged 9-13 competing to be ‘Junior Bake Off’ Champion by taking part in a series of Technical Bakes and Showstopper Challenges using their own original recipes
results.name: Junior Bake Off

results.overview: Hosted by Marie-Ève ​​Janvier and Joël Legendre, the competition welcomes 10 amateur pastry chefs, only one of whom will walk away with the title of Best Pastry Chef in Quebec. Each episode, the candidates will compete in culinary prowess and take on different colorful challenges in order to impress the judges and renowned professional pastry chefs, Gaël Vidricaire and Joël Lahon.
results.name: Le meilleur pâtissier du Québec

results.overview: Teams of professional pastry chefs do battle in the kitchen.
results.name: Bake Off: The Professionals
